# Brand Services

> > Brand Services provides FM 4991 certified fire protection, firestopping, and life safety services across New England, Mid-Atlantic, and Southeastern regions.

Founded in 1994, Brand Services specializes in passive fire protection, fireproofing, fire door inspection, and facility safety compliance for healthcare, commercial, and industrial facilities. The company maintains certifications including FM 4991, UL, and serves Joint Commission-regulated organizations with comprehensive safety solutions and digital reporting through TraXus.

## Key Topics

- FM 4991 Certification
- Firestopping
- Fire Protection
- Fireproofing
- Life Safety Compliance
- NFPA 80 & NFPA 101
- Joint Commission Standards
- Healthcare Facilities
- Commercial Construction
- Fire Door Inspection
- Passive Fire Protection
- UL Certification
- TraXus Reporting System
- Code Compliance
- Ligature Risk Assessment

## Core Fire Protection Services

- [Brand Services – Safety Services, Fire Protection, Fireproofing](https://brand-svc.com): Trusted life safety & FM 4991 firestop contractor since 1994
- [Construction - Brand Services](https://brand-svc.com/services/fire-protection-life-safety-services-for-new-commercial-construction-facilities): FM 4991 certified firestopping contractor for commercial construction
- [Reporting - Brand Services](https://brand-svc.com/services/facility-services-reporting): TraXus digital reporting system for Joint Commission compliance tracking
- [Facility Operations - Brand Services](https://brand-svc.com/services/facility-operations): Engineering, commissioning & LEED certification facility operations services
- [Photoluminescence - Brand Services](https://brand-svc.com/services/photoluminescence): NFPA 101 compliant photoluminescent egress path marking & exit signs

## Specialized Safety Services

- [Ballistics - Brand Services](https://brand-svc.com/services/facility-services-ballistics): UL752-certified ballistic barriers, window shades & door shields
- [Ligature - Brand Services](https://brand-svc.com/services/ligature): Joint Commission ligature risk assessment for behavioral health facilities
- [Door Training - Brand Services](https://brand-svc.com/services/door-training): NFPA 80 fire door inspection training by DHI certified expert Joe Glaski
